daily.pageDescription: Log mortality and feed for several cages at once. Feed amounts deduct stock through the inventory ledger.

daily.stockingCreated: Stocking created. After approval the cage appears here

harvest.previewComplete: Saving empties {name}: its fish count goes to 0, it is marked harvested and its stocking cycle closes.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Approvals, alerts and reminders for you. Choose channels and quiet hours in Settings.

approvals.title: Approval alerts
approvals.intro: Tell approvers when stocking, top-up, transfer or join requests wait for them, and escalate to admins if nobody acts.

stockCount.cancelConfirm: Cancel this count? Nothing will be adjusted.
stockCount.postConfirm: Post this count? Each counted difference becomes a stock adjustment at this site.

common.name: Name
common.truncated: Some figures are partial: this period has more records than one report reads. Choose a shorter range.

group.title: Group reports
group.description: Read-only figures for your organization and for subsidiaries that share their reports with you. Amounts stay in each organization’s currency.
group.currencies: Organizations use different currencies; amounts are not converted or added up.
group.noSubsidiariesHint: Link a subsidiary in Organization structure; its admins accept and choose to share reports.

regions.title: Regional report
regions.description: Figures per site, filtered by region or business unit.

structure.title: Organization structure
structure.description: Group sites into regions and business units, and link subsidiaries for group reporting. All optional: a single-site farm needs none of it.
structure.unitsHint: Up to three levels, e.g. Region › Business unit.
structure.noUnits: No regions or business units yet.
structure.sitesHint: Choose the region or business unit of each site.
structure.linksHint: Ask another organization to become a subsidiary by its company code. Its admins accept and decide whether to share reports with you.

teams.title: Teams
teams.description: Departments and teams, their members and leads. Assign tasks and send messages to a whole team.
teams.emptyHint: An admin can create departments and teams here.

workforce.title: Workforce

workforce.accountHint: Link if this person signs in
workforce.emptyHint: Workforce admins can add staff here.

inbound.name: Name
inbound.emptyHint: Add one to receive events from another system.
